title: Synthetic example: invoice-follow-up pilot
product: A founder-operated invoice-reminder pilot for small design agencies
target_customer: Hypothesis: small design agencies where the owner still follows up overdue invoices. Exclude agencies with a working automated collection process.
buyer: Agency owner, hypothesized budget owner; purchasing authority unconfirmed
user: Owner or operations coordinator doing follow-up; distinct from confirmed buyer
search_scope: Two synthetic supplied records for demonstration. No public research was performed.
verdict: One potential interview prospect fits the supplied workflow signal; no purchase or pilot commitment is established. A second agency remains speculative.

sources.limitations: Invented test data. No actual owner, website read, budget or willingness to pay. Dates are synthetic.

outreach_plan.angle: Learn the current workaround before proposing a small pilot.
outreach_plan.first_step: Prepare one neutral interview draft; a real contact and sending authority are still absent.
outreach_plan.follow_up: After a separately authorized conversation, ask about the last real invoice and what the owner already tried.
outreach_plan.success: Learning goal: document one actual workflow and identify who approves spend. This example supplies no measured outcomes.
stop_rules: Do not send messages or contact fictional companies.
For real outreach, stop follow-ups after any reply; assess the reply before further action.
Honor any opt-out across channels; do not evade it through another address.
If no relevant evidence can be found, return an empty qualified shortlist.

limits: Everything in this example is synthetic; it is not demand evidence.
Scores rank supplied hypotheses and are not conversion probabilities.
The checker validates shape, references, dates and arithmetic only. It cannot establish truth, source access, consent or buyer status.
